item.title: Warner Bros reopens takeover talks with Paramount after receiving a waiver from Netflix
item.description: Warner Bros. will reopen takeover talks with Paramount Skydance after receiving a seven-day waiver to do so from its preferred bidder, Netflix.

item.title: There's a dog in the photo? Instagram users are only looking at this Burbank officer
item.description: A Burbank police officer has gone viral after the department shared a photo of him holding a dog on Instagram - and let's just say there were plenty of heart-eyes emojis!

item.title: Pressure intensifies on Casey Wasserman to resign as LA Olympics chair
item.description: Calls are intensifying for Casey Wasserman to step down as chairman of the Los Angeles Olympics organizing committee over his ties to Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Future leaders wanted to shape 2026 Boyle Heights Youth Festival
item.description: Friday, teens and young adults ages 14-24 can learn how to make an impact and gain community service hours while planning one of the area's biggest youth-led festivals in Boyle Heights.

item.title: 4 killed in pile-up crash involving more than 30 vehicles in Colorado, police say
item.description: At least four people were killed and 30 vehicles were involved in a pile-up crash in Colorado.

item.title: Storm timeline: 2 more storms to move through SoCal after heavy rainfall Monday
item.description: Southern California will see a heavy overnight storm after a brief break in the rain on Tuesday. Then, a third storm arrives on Thursday.

item.title: Rescuers race to save 6 skiers trapped in Sierra Nevada avalanche that's left 10 more missing
item.description: Six backcountry skiers were found alive and 10 others were still missing Tuesday in an avalanche in Northern California during a powerful winter storm moving through the state.

item.title: Cause of death revealed for Victoria Jones, daughter of actor Tommy Lee Jones
item.description: The Office of the Chief Medical Examiner in San Francisco revealed the cause of death of Victoria Jones, daughter of actor Tommy Lee Jones. She was found deceased in a San Francisco hotel on New Year's Day.

item.title: Family files $28.5M claim for damages after man hit and killed by Riverside bus
item.description: The family of a 28-year-old man who was hit and run over by a Riverside Transit Agency bus last November has filed a claim for damages against the agency for $28.5 million.

item.title: LAUSD board approves plan that could lead to major layoffs
item.description: The Los Angeles Unified School District Board of Education voted 4-3 in favor of a proposal that could lead to mass layoffs.
